title: Junior Prep Setup
subtitle: A quick profile — we'll use your account name and help you build a school list your way.
welcome:
We'll use the **display name on your account** — no need to type it again.

Tell us a bit about your interests, then choose whether you want to add schools yourself or get a starter list from Seldom. You can change everything later.
completeMessage: Your prep workspace is ready. Open **Schools you are exploring** to add or review your list — each school gets a standard admission timeline.
